contracts.coordinates: +X forward, +Z up, game scale; wheeled origin ground zero.
contracts.turrets: TURRET yaw; BARREL pitch child; MUZZLE01/MUZZLEFX01 muzzle and fire FX; TREADSL/TREADSR scrolling.
contracts.wheels: TIRE01..06: front left/right first, then rear axle pairs. Tigr has four, supply six.
contracts.factory: EXITSTART (-10,-30,.3), EXITEND (53,-30,.3); production SpawnPoint/ExitPoint should match. Repair docking uses DOCKSTART/ACTION/END plus nine WAITING bones. Bay is permanently open.
contracts.supply: China SupplyTruck collection workflow; DOCKSTART (47,-20,.3), DOCKACTION (22,-20,.3), DOCKEND (48,-20,.3); nine waiting bones. Build truck SpawnPoint/ExitPoint (20,20,.3)/(55,20,.3).
contracts.airfield: USA 2x2 runway parking contract, all 17 standard public parking/runway/heli bones included. List these as ExtraPublicBone in Draw.
contracts.infantry: Original authored full-size articulated rig at ModelScale1.0. MODEL.MODEL_I explicit idle/reset, _R run, _F attack, _X death. No stock skeleton dependency; knees/ankles remain attached throughout motion.
contracts.helicopter: RUMI28.RUMI28 loop spins PROPELLER01/02; WEAPONA01..04 and WEAPONB01..04; TURRET/BARREL gun.
contracts.wrecks: Vehicles use original _D as wreck visual; buildings _E/_EN use compressed burned shells. Infantry death uses the original articulated _X clip.
contracts.night: Building night variants are present; dedicated illuminated night repaint is deferred.
